plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Classics — Classical Civilization Track (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Complete 14 hours of a foreign language through the intermediate level. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See academic advisor.
[grid1 fn2] At least 3 hours must be in MATH. Three hours may be PHIL 240 .
[grid1 fn3] Select from ANTH 300-499; ARCH 430 , ARCH 434 ; ARTS 335 ; CLAS 220 , CLAS 230-499; HIST 300-499. Students must make a grade of C or better in all courses taken.
[grid1 fn4] Select from any 100-499 courses not used elsewhere, except CLAS 300-499. Only 14 hours of KINE 199 ; AERS 100-499; MLSC 100-499; NVSC 100-499; SOMS 100-499 may be used towards general electives.
[grid1 fn5] Select from ANTH 316 , ANTH 317/RELS 317 ; CLAS 220 , CLAS 230-499; PHIL 410 , PHIL 411 . Students must make a grade of C or better in all courses taken.
[grid1 fn6] Must make grade of C or better.
